info.title: GATEWAY-apiwizruntimedoc-Replace Carrental Reservations Extend-v1-spec
info.description: The Extend Car Rental Reservations API allows users to modify existing car rental reservations by extending their duration. This functionality is pivotal for customers who need to adjust their travel plans and require continued access to their rental vehicles. The API supports typical operations such as altering reservation dates and times, ensuring a seamless experience for customers and service providers. It is particularly useful for travel agencies and booking platforms that manage car rental services on behalf of users.

put.description: This endpoint allows users to extend an existing reservation by modifying its duration or dates. Users must provide the necessary details to successfully extend the reservation.

requestBody.description: Request body for extending a reservation. This body should contain details about the reservation that is to be extended, including the new end date and any other necessary information.

200.description: Request completed successfully, and the reservation has been extended.

requestId.description: A unique identifier for the request.

referenceNumber.description: A reference number associated with the reservation.

customer.description: Details of the customer making the reservation.

priority.description: The priority level of the reservation request.

amount.description: The total amount for the reservation.

currency.description: The currency in which the amount is denoted.

notificationRequired.description: Indicates whether a notification is required for this reservation.

requestedAt.description: The date and time when the reservation was requested.

channel.description: The channel through which the reservation was made.

recordIndex.description: The index of the record in the system.

ReplaceCarrentalReservationsExtendReques.description: Schema representing the request body for updating a reservation.

firstName.description: The first name of the customer.

lastName.description: The last name of the customer.

email.description: The email address of the customer.

vipCustomer.description: Indicates whether the customer is a VIP.

Customer.description: Schema representing the customer details for the reservation.

ReplaceCarrentalReservationsExtendRespon.title: Reservation Update Response

status.description: Indicates whether the update operation was successful.

referenceNumber.description: A unique reference number associated with the reservation.

resultId.description: The identifier for the result of the update operation.

state.description: The current state of the reservation after the update.

processingTimeMs.description: The time taken to process the update request in milliseconds.

message.description: A message providing additional context about the result of the operation.

audit.description: Details about the auditing information for this operation.

ReplaceCarrentalReservationsExtendRespon.description: This schema represents the response received after updating a reservation.

AuditInfo.title: Audit Information

createdBy.description: The user or system that created the reservation.

createdAt.description: The timestamp when the reservation was created.

automated.description: Indicates whether the reservation was created through an automated process.

AuditInfo.description: Contains details about the audit of the reservation update operation.

x-processing-time.description: Indicates the time, in milliseconds, taken to process the request. A value of 0 signifies that the processing time was negligible.
